question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Disdain
solution:
The correct answer is **"Contempt."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Disdain"** means to have a feeling of contempt or strong dislike towards someone or something. (यह भावना कि कोई सम्मानीय नहीं है, तिरस्‍कार, अवज्ञा)

 
 
• **Example**: *She showed **disdain**__ towards the idea of working with him.*
 
 
 
• **"Contempt"** is a synonym of **"disdain."**
 
• It means to have a feeling of disrespect or disregard towards someone or something. (यह भावना कि कोई व्यक्ति सम्मान का हक़दार नहीं है तथा उसका कोई महत्व नहीं है; तिरस्‍कार, अवज्ञा)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The teacher treated my question with **contempt**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Acceptance** means to agree or approve of something. (स्‍वीकार करने या स्‍वीकार्य होने की क्रिया)
 
• **Admiration** means to have a feeling of respect or approval towards someone or something. (किसी वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति के प्रति विशेष अनुराग और समादर की भावना)
 
• **Withdraw** means to remove or take back something. (कहीं से (पीछे या दूर) हट जाना या किसी को हटा देना)
